title: Not all that impressed: "flimsy", and unsure it is "food-safe"
text: Not all that impressed: "flimsy", and unsure it is "food-safe". Though I decided not to return this item, I think that it is awfully flimsy and the lid is pretty worthless. There are better quality Silicone products out there, and speaking of silicone, I suspect this item isnt 'pure' silicone, as you can see 'white' when you apply pressure with your fingernail (that is supposed to be a big indicator of other chemicals involved)…. so I am not so sure its totally food-safe when heated or microwaved. I'm using it as a bar-soap dish.
